result.rationale: The handler first checks `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED) return res.status(403)...`, and constants.ts defines `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED = process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`. So when CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset, the request is rejected at the first guard before reaching the header comparison; the undefined===undefined bypass cannot occur.

adjudication.rationale: The handler first checks `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED) return 403;` where `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (packages/lib/constants.ts). If `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is unset (or empty), this value is falsy and the request is rejected before reaching the header/secret comparison, so an `undefined === undefined` bypass cannot occur as described.
